description_blocks.text:
Generic 125 x 100 x 63.5 mm SFX body reference for compact-case planning. The linked Intel reduced-depth package drawing supplies the mechanical context; no exact vendor PSU is represented.

Generic documentation reference, not manufacturer-certified fit geometry. This 125 mm wide, 100 mm deep body must not be substituted for SFX-L or other SFX package profiles. Intel's illustrated fan projection is outside the body dimensions. Verify the selected PSU's mounting-hole locations, complete fan/grille envelope, connector and switch layout, cable bend space, and ventilation before designing a printed case. No wattage, electrical conformity, exact SKU, price, or inventory stock is inferred.

specifications.CAD coverage: Documentation only; no CAD model attached
specifications.Clearance coverage: Body reference only; connector, cable bend, inlet, switch, fan and airflow clearances must be designed separately
specifications.Form factor: SFX12V; 125 mm rear-face width, reduced-depth body
specifications.Guide profile limitation: The illustrated top-mount fan projects 17 mm beyond the 63.5 mm body; inspect the chosen PSU's complete envelope
specifications.Mounting reference: Three No. 6-32 UNC-2B holes in the linked package drawing; verify the chosen PSU
